note: §0/§4: the node key is *the terminal successor of the key that signed event 1*, not the key this process happens to hold. A deployment that has rotated its node key must keep being able to admit its own `Deployment`, so `admitBy: nodeKey` asks `head/2` — and the answer here is `$key.2`, which never signed event 1. Debt #40 is the entry this closes; the vector is what stops it reopening.
